findings.title: On a phone the step 7 note sends the student to a 'sidebar' button that does not exist there
findings.evidence: Student guest, About page: the note under 'The faculty dashboard' reads 'Use the Faculty guest button in the sidebar.' At <=600px the sidebar side-bottom is display:none and the Faculty guest button only lives in the Guest options popover. The intro paragraph above already says '(on a phone, in Guest options)', so the page contradicts itself on a phone. Screenshot a9_phone_popover_about.png shows the note next to the open popover.
findings.repro: scratchpad/r16-C/a8_student.mjs (prints the step 7 text) and a9_student_about.mjs; shot r16-C/shots/a9_phone_popover_about.png
findings.expected: Phone wording consistent with the intro (Guest options), or a neutral 'Use the Faculty guest button'.
findings.actual: '...button in the sidebar.' on every viewport.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/pages/about.tsx (the about-step-note span): drop 'in the sidebar' or say 'in the sidebar (on a phone, in Guest options)'.

findings.title: In the Faculty guest, step 7 still says 'Switch to the Faculty guest' and has no marker that it is the current guest
findings.evidence: Faculty guest, About page: step 7 text starts 'Switch to the Faculty guest, then show the class analytics...' although the viewer is already in it; the other steps get an 'In the student guest' chip or 'You are here', but step 7 shows only the time chip and the two Open buttons. Screenshot a2_phone_step7.png.
findings.expected: Copy or chip adapted to the role (for example 'You are in the Faculty guest' / 'Show the class analytics...').
findings.actual: Student-oriented imperative shown to the faculty guest.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/lib/demo-guide.ts step 'faculty' purpose + web/src/pages/about.tsx: add a role-aware purpose or an 'In the Faculty guest' chip when stepNeeds() is null and step.guest is set.
